summary: CR-489 (lock order edit after bill print). I checked the code for V-1 to V-13 and ran the dashboard in the browser as owner@cafe103.com. The code markers are present, V-1 to V-3 are correct and webpack compiles with only the old L1888 warning. The lock itself does NOT work. Both OrderEntry and OrderCard read restaurant?.orderEditAccess, but profileTransform stores the flag at restaurant.settings.orderEditAccess. I confirmed this from the live React state: restaurant.orderEditAccess is undefined (it does not exist at the top level of the restaurant object) and restaurant.settings.orderEditAccess is true. The profile API returns order_edit_access:'Yes' and employee-orders-list returns bill_print:'Yes' for 1537757, but isEditLocked is always false. Order 1537757 (bill printed) still shows print-kot-btn and cancel-order-btn in Order View. The expected reduced button set did not appear.

ui_bugs.issue: isEditLocked reads restaurant?.orderEditAccess (undefined). The value lives at restaurant.settings.orderEditAccess (profileTransform L425 is inside fromAPI.settings, which is stored as restaurant.settings at L222). So the lock never activates.

integration_issues.flow: Bill printed + setting ON + user without order_edit_access
integration_issues.issue: Order 1537757 (bill_print=Yes) shows these buttons: bill-btn, cancel-order-btn, print-kot-btn, served-toggle. Unprinted orders 1537752/1537753 show cancel/print-kot/ready (plus merge/shift on 1537752). There is no difference, so the lock is not applied.

action_items: CRITICAL: change restaurant?.orderEditAccess to restaurant?.settings?.orderEditAccess in OrderCard.jsx L122 and OrderEntry.jsx L365. Alternatively, also expose orderEditAccess at the top level of the restaurant object in profileTransform.

Scope gap vs spec ('block all actions except Collect Payment and Reprint Bill'). OrderEntry only gates order cancel and item cancel. Adding items, changing quantities, Update Order/KOT, shift/merge/food-transfer from OrderEntry, and discount are not gated. OrderCard leaves served-toggle, item-action-btn and food-transfer-btn ungated, along with the TableCard actions in Table View.
orderData.billPrinted in OrderEntry is a prop snapshot. After printing inside the same OrderEntry session, the lock will not apply until orderData refreshes.
critical_code_review_comments: Field-path mismatch: profileTransform.settings() writes to restaurant.settings.*, while consumers read the top level of the restaurant object. Other flags follow the settings.* pattern, e.g. restaurant?.settings?.whatsappMessage in OrderCard L141.
restaurantSettingsTransform maps order_edit_access both ways (L99/L250), but no settings-page UI reads or writes orderEditAccess.
There is no unit test for orderEditAccess in profileTransform.test.js.

success_rate.backend: N/A (no backend changes; external preprod API)
success_rate.frontend: Code checks: 11 of 13 V-items look correct in code but are not effective. V-4/V-7 (isEditLocked derivation) are broken. Browser lock check: 0 of 2 passed.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Log in at the frontend URL using the data-testids login-email, login-password and login-button. Wait about 18s, then click the view-toggle testid to switch to Order View, where OrderCard renders with order-card-{id}. At cafe103, 1537757 has bill_print=Yes; 1537752 and 1537753 are unprinted. Profile returns order_edit_access='Yes'. After the fix, expect print-kot-btn-1537757 and cancel-order-btn-1537757 to be absent while bill-btn-1537757 stays.
rca of the issue: profileTransform L222 builds the restaurant as { ..., settings: fromAPI.settings(api) }, and L425 adds orderEditAccess inside that settings object. OrderCard/OrderEntry read restaurant.orderEditAccess, which is undefined, so !!undefined is false and isEditLocked is always false. Reproduce: log in as the owner, switch to Order View, and note that order 1537757 still shows its KOT and Cancel buttons. Fix: read restaurant?.settings?.orderEditAccess.
